questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All insects are birds.

Some birds are fishes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All fishes are insects.

II. Some fishes are insects.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6030d3fbb8c2bb5e4865d9c695f34357c8c6d648ae0ef1a39d598794dfb2e672.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab6cb093fcc064c31a3fef0b369d674c116d0feb87aefdbc5844c03c01310a0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All fishes are insects → Does not follow (As all insects are birds and some birds are fishes. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some fishes are insects → Does not follow (As all insects are birds and some birds are fishes. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b22df3915b94145d472ee4952eb7fe5baad9ae1168219a78448692c72d8959.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

As, there are 3 same types of shapes, therefore number of triangles will be = (3 × 3) → 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fe9ce5171dbd5ab63bb34fa9526e242007a16fd7a17b5e95d97b9ac72ac88a.png] 

 

2) Number of triangles = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/341ca9514b759e530cb9166f14cad7053c6fa6bcb4664c0ae889ea0e944d1ec7.png] 

Thus, as marked there are a total of (9 + 2) = 11 triangles

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Muskan, Amrita, Pranjali, Deepti, Riya and Sonali are six friends sitting around a circle facing the centre. Muskan is between Amrita and Pranjali. Amrita is opposite to Deepti. Riya is not the immediate neighbour of Amrita. Who is opposite to Sonali?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Muskan, Amrita, Pranjali, Deepti, Riya and Sonali are six friends sitting around a circle facing the centre.

1) Amrita is opposite to Deepti.

2) Riya is not the immediate neighbour of Amrita.

3) Muskan is between Amrita and Pranjali.

After positioning Muskan, Pranjali and Riya only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Sonali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31b3aab902bf6812379ff756eb4325fecdd05beb63626183576e60cac788ed23.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04eb0511b2395dc60a7a14dff5ef3f842900da1f8d6ac379ab57826a8445710e.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Pranjali is opposite to Sonali.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
Given series: A Q _ _ S A _ W E _ A _ _ E S _ Q W _ S

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) WESQWAWE → A Q __W__ __E__ S A __S__ W E __Q__ A __W__ __A__ E S __W__ Q W __E__ S → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/ deleting/ multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.

(205, 146, 87)

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: 1st number - 59 = 2nd number; 2nd number - 59 = 3rd number.

Now,

For (205, 146, 87):

⇒ 205 - 59 = 146

⇒ 146 - 59 = 87.

For (333, 274, 215):

⇒ 333 - 59 = 274

⇒ 274 - 59 = 215.

Similarly, for **(188, 129, 70)**

**⇒ 188 - 59 = 129**

**⇒ 129 - 59 = 70.**

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
